`missing_hypothesis_sources.json` is the exact raw Qwen response from decision 13 of local run `studio-809c0f1646f94714a85f` (9 September 2026). It omits the required hypothesis sources. Its artistic/historical claims are model proposals, not verified facts or human judgments. Tests preserve the omission and require tool feedback; they must never fill in a reference to make it valid.

`trace_16_step.json` preserves the 16 recorded actions/raw completions from `studio-29fd86d2de4540338c92`, original step hashes, and deduplicated opened source evidence. Filesystem paths are portable projections; the original image bytes remain in the local artifact archive. Missing reasons remain null. Replay does not add replacement decisions or infer human feedback. Source interpretation in model hypotheses is unverified and sometimes contradictory.

`missing_observation_bracket.json` preserves the exact rejected `response-004.json` completion from `studio-404d3b553ae24c5c8cb9`, its raw-text/file hashes and token counts. The observation array lacks a closing bracket. Tests retain that failure and separately exercise prospective token filtering; synthetic well-formed comparisons are never written back to the run. Its image observations are unverified model statements.

`unsupported_property_attribution.json` preserves the three exact rejected draft completions (steps 3–5) from `studio-901a68c896cc482b8262`, their raw/file hashes and a projection of the opened source text/claims. Model claims of sacred materiality and agency remain unverified and fail the extractive attribution check. Synthetic corrected test inputs are separately authored software fixtures, never recovered model outputs.
